data.name: HeroDescription
data.value: AntAbstract is your solution partner that combines technology and experience to manage your academic conferences from planning to conclusion.

data.name: WhyTitle
data.value: We make conference management faster, more organized, and more reliable.

data.name: WhyText1
data.value: It is a functional software system that enables you to manage your national and international conferences, symposia, and workshops online, transcending physical boundaries.

data.name: WhyText2
data.value: It brings together core academic operations such as abstract submission, peer review, registration processes, payment tracking, and proceeding book management on a single platform.

data.name: Feature1Text
data.value: Simplifies the abstract submission process for authors and tracks all applications in an organized manner.

data.name: Feature2Text
data.value: Makes reviewer assignment, evaluation, and decision processes more controlled and transparent.

data.name: Feature3Text
data.value: Allows you to easily manage registration, attendance, and user operations from a single panel.

data.name: Feature4Text
data.value: Presents published proceeding books in a digital archive in an organized and accessible manner.

data.name: CtaTitle
data.value: Ready to digitize your conference processes?

data.name: CtaText
data.value: Manage your academic events more professionally end-to-end with AntAbstract.
